snippet.title: World's Goodest Pup is launched!!
snippet.description:
After 2 years, our dog show deckbuilder is live on Steam! Play today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2867220/Worlds_Goodest_Pup/

In World’s Goodest Pup, you play as a pup trying to make it in the world of competitive dog shows. You’ll play each of 3 breeds - each with unique abilities, personalities, and storylines - then strategically build your deck of tricks, poses, and accessories as you wag and bark your way into the competition!

You’ll also build your dream pet resort - where you can cuddle and spoil your fluffy friends to your heart’s content. Unlock new items and decorations which give bonus perks to your pups that will help them during their competition runs. Visit the pet store, bring your puppos to the dog spa, and keep your dogs happy to boost their abilities and become the best dog in the world!
